product.title: Kimono Tea Ceremony Experience at Kyoto Oritsuruya, Nishiki

description.text: In Kyoto, this two-hour cultural session at Nishiki Orizuruya pairs kimono dressing and simple hairstyling with a matcha ceremony and seasonal wagashi. A licensed guide covers tea-room etiquette and matcha preparation, with an optional calligraphy window in the same tea house near Nishiki Market. The group is capped at ten. Hotel pickup is not listed; the meeting point is a short walk from Hankyu Karasuma or subway Shijo. The format suits visitors who want a guided tea-and-kimono window without booking a full temple circuit. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Kyoto, and the itinerary stays on Nishiki Orizuruya and Nishiki Market that define this session rather than a Fushimi Inari hike.

highlights: Two-hour kimono dressing and matcha ceremony in Nishiki
Wagashi, utensils, and simple hairstyling included
Meet at Nishiki Orizuruya near Nishiki Market

start.description: Meet at Nishiki Orizuruya, 452 Jumonjicho, Nakagyo Ward, a short walk from Hankyu Karasuma Station exit 13 or Kyoto Municipal Subway Shijo Station.

end.description: Return to your Kyoto meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
